text:
deploy-bot: started rollout r2026.03.17 -> runtime-cluster (canary 5%) at 2026-03-17T14:02:47Z. config: kernel-opt=auto, batch-window=adaptive. link: https://console.redwood.local/deploys/r2026.03.17

incidents-bot: ALERT: service/runtime-v2 p95 latency +220% on canary slice | error rate +0.6% | kernel-fallback events detected (see /alerts/4181234567) :rotating_light:

alice.sre: paging @ben-oncall, looks like canary traffic showing large tail latency. Kernel fallback count jumped to 180 in 3m.

ben-oncall: oncall ack — digging into traces & host metrics now. @carol-runtime can you confirm if the new kernel selection change was toggled for canary only?

carol-runtime: yes kernel-opt=auto was enabled in the canary config. I see a pattern: longer seq requests cause fallback to CPU kernels and batch assembly time spikes. KV cache hit rate dropped ~12%.

erin-support: seeing customer-facing errors on chat endpoints (timeout 504s) for 3 customers on EU region — support case ids #3421 #3422 #3423. ETA to mitigation?

ben-oncall: timeline: 14:05 started seeing p95 +250% from baseline. 14:07 kernel fallback spiked. 14:09 canary hosts started dropping into CPU path. Impacted endpoints: /chat/stream, /generate.

carol-runtime: logs snippet:
```
[14:07:12] kernel_fallback: model=gptx-13b ver=quant-v1 host=rc-12 msg="kernel mismatch->cpu"
[14:07:14] batch_assemble_ms=84 -> 420
[14:07:18] kv_cache_hit=0.68 -> 0.56
```

alice.sre: @ben-oncall if this is causing customer-visible 504s we should cut traffic and enable rollback/kill-switch. Recommend flip canary to 0% while we assess.

frank-pm: customers on trial orgs are experiencing degraded experience. We should notify CS and pause new signups in the EU region until cleared.

ben-oncall: agreed. Initiating canary traffic cut and engage rollback plan. Executing: `deployctl traffic set runtime-cluster --canary 0`

deploy-bot: command accepted. canary traffic set to 0% for r2026.03.17. Rolling back canary slice.

incidents-bot: ACTION_LOG: canary traffic cut to 0% by ben-oncall at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z. Note: automatic fallback to previous model variant scheduled if rollback completes.

carol-runtime: while traffic is cut, start immediate mitigation: disable kernel-opt=auto and revert quant-kernel selection for canary hosts. Commands below:
```
// revert flag
cfgctl set runtime/kernel-opt canary off
// pin kernel
cfgctl set runtime/kernel-selection gptx-13b:quant-v1:kernel=fastfp16
```

gina-ops: rolling the kernel selection revert now to affected hosts rc-11..rc-14.

ben-oncall: monitoring latency and error rate. p95 back to +30% (still elevated) after traffic cut. KV hit rate recovering slowly.

erin-support: notifying impacted customers with interim message: "We detected elevated latency on a canary release and cut the rollout. No action needed on your side; we are continuing to investigate." Sent for #3421 #3422 #3423.

frank-pm: good comms. Please include expected next update in 30m in the customer note.

carol-runtime: initial hypothesis: kernel auto-selection used a new heuristic that misclassified some attention shapes causing heavier kernels and longer batch cooldowns. That triggered prefetch/backpressure and KV thrash. Need a revert and a deeper regression test for sequence-length distributions.

alice.sre: agree. For now we should abort the release until we have a validated kernel-policy test and perf regression <5% at canary. Propose rolling forward a hotfix (tweak selection thresholds) only after bench + canary smoke.

ben-oncall: starting rollback to previous stable release r2026.03.16 on runtime-cluster. `deployctl rollback --to r2026.03.16 --force`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated to r2026.03.16. Estimated time ~3m per slice.

incidents-bot: PAGE: handoff to next on-call (alice.sre) at 14:30 for long tail monitoring. Current state: canary=0, rollback in progress, kernel flags reverted on canary hosts, partial recovery in p95 to +15%.

alice.sre: taking Handoff. Ben, leave notes in the incident doc please (link: https://incidents.redwood.local/4181234567). I'll coordinate with runtime for post-rollback validation.

ben-oncall: added logs + commands executed to incident doc. Leaving for alice.sre.

carol-runtime: rollback completed on all slices at 14:24. Post-rollback checks:
- p95 within 2% of baseline after 10m
- error rate normalized
- KV hit rate returned to pre-deploy levels

alice.sre: verifying synthetic checks and customer-facing endpoints. Running load cert checks and sampling traces.

erin-support: update sent to affected customers with ETA for postmortem. CS will follow up with any escalations.

frank-pm: can we capture a short postmortem blurb ASAP for customers? Need cause + mitigation + ETA for fix.

carol-runtime: draft postmortem blurb: "A change to kernel auto-selection in release r2026.03.17 caused misclassification under long-sequence workloads, triggering fallback to slower kernels and increased batching latency. We cut canary traffic, reverted kernel flags, and rolled back to r2026.03.16. Root cause analysis and validation tests for kernel-selection heuristics are in progress."

alice.sre: lgtm. Add remediation: add synthetic tests with varied sequence-length distribution, gate kernel-opt behind rollout flag, and add automatic rollback threshold at p95 +40% in canary.

gina-ops: opened ticket OPS-9981 to add canary automation and guardrails. Assigned to @carol-runtime and due 2026-03-24.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT_STATE: resolved -> remediate (canary rollback + kernel revert performed). Incident created: INC-4181234567. Severity: Sev2.

alice.sre: final note: if any customers report continued issues, ping this thread. We'll keep monitoring for 2 hours and then hand back to normal ops.

erin-support: will escalate any customer reports immediately. Closing customer-facing loop now.

frank-pm: thanks team. Good coordinated response. We'll schedule a 1-hour RCA tomorrow.

alice.sre: handoff complete at 14:54. Monitoring window started.

carol-runtime: thanks all — will prepare regression test plan and mark the release blocked until tests pass.

ben-oncall: back to rotation.

deploy-bot: note: automated rollback metrics archived to https://console.redwood.local/deploys/r2026.03.17/logs/4181234567
